# Acceptance test report

**9/9 tests PASS** (63/63 checks). Blender 4.2.23 LTS, runtime 26.53 s. Generated by `wrapper/run_acceptance_tests.py`.

Tolerances: Blender stores transforms in float32 (~1e-7 relative), so geometric equalities are checked at 1 µm / 1e-6 relative — four orders of magnitude below one rendered pixel (≈0.22 mm at the eye).
